findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description did not identify charge and energy conservation precisely.
findings.resolution: Specified charge at nodes and energy in closed meshes.

findings.summary: The voltage formula used an inconsistent decimal form.
evidence: The previous formula used a dot decimal.

findings.summary: The TCR description did not identify the changing component resistance.
findings.resolution: Named the resistance of a component explicitly.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name omitted the density qualifier.
evidence: The previous name did not clearly represent q'' per area.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Densidade do fluxo de calor.

findings.summary: The current-capacity instruction did not clearly express current-carrying capacity.
findings.resolution: Used capacidade de condução de corrente and retained product-data and standards guidance.
